entities.summary: Kutaisi State Historical Museum, formally known as the Niko Berdzenishvili Kutaisi State History Museum, is a museum in Kutaisi, Georgia. It is major museum, and is also considered to be one of the most important scientific-research institutions in Georgia with its extensive research library and laboratory.
